Write storyboard.json for this:

Write the script for this flow: Explain our CI pipeline: a developer pushes a branch to GitHub, GitHub Actions runs the lint, the tests and a build in parallel, and when all pass it publishes a Docker image to the registry and deploys it to staging.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors. Ignored by explAIn-it.

nodes.description: The graph nodes shown in this scene.

caption.description: The step caption shown on screen.

say.description: The narration line. Without it the beat is timed by its actions and caption.

anyOf.description: The node rises into the scene.
The edge draws in and carries a moving dot.
The node pulses to draw attention.
A card with text next to the node, shown until the narration ends.
Everything but these nodes fades back from here to the next dim or the next beat without one; a dim in a scene's last beat holds to its end.
A small status chip on the node.

notes.description: The author's own notes; never shown.

storyboard.description: The story told over a graph: scenes, and beats within them.

titleCard.description: A title card to suggest: the video's name, and a line under it.

assumptions.description: What you assumed where the description left it open, each in a sentence.

reply.text: {"storyboard":{"version":1,"scenes":[{"id":"pipeline","title":"Push to staging","nodes":["dev","github","actions","lint","tests","build","gate","registry","staging"],"beats":[{"id":"hook","caption":"A developer pushes a branch to GitHub.","say":"Every change you push should be checked before it reaches staging.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"dev"},{"type":"appear","node":"github"},{"type":"flow","edge":"push","label":"push branch"}]},{"id":"trigger","caption":"GitHub Actions starts the pipeline.","say":"GitHub tells the pipeline about the push, and GitHub Actions starts a run.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"actions"},{"type":"flow","edge":"trigger","label":"webhook"},{"type":"highlight","node":"actions"}]},{"id":"checks","caption":"Lint, tests and build run side by side.","say":"Lint, the tests and the build all run at the same time, so the checks finish sooner.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"lint"},{"type":"appear","node":"tests"},{"type":"appear","node":"build"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_lint","label":"run"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_tests","label":"run"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_build","label":"run"}]},{"id":"results","caption":"Each check reports its result to the gate.","say":"Each check sends its result back to one gate.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"gate"},{"type":"flow","edge":"lint_done","label":"result"},{"type":"flow","edge":"tests_done","label":"result"},{"type":"flow","edge":"build_done","label":"result"},{"type":"highlight","node":"gate"}]},{"id":"decide","caption":"The gate asks: did all three pass?","say":"The pipeline publishes only when every check has passed.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["gate","lint","tests","build"]},{"type":"badge","node":"gate","text":"all pass","tone":"ok"}]},{"id":"publish","caption":"The image is pushed to the registry.","say":"The tested build is packaged as a Docker image and pushed to the image registry.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"registry"},{"type":"flow","edge":"publish","label":"all pass: push image"},{"type":"callout","node":"registry","title":"Docker image","text":"The exact build that passed all checks."}]},{"id":"outcome","caption":"The change is running on staging.","say":"The registry hands the image to staging, so your change is now running there, ready to try.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"staging"},{"type":"flow","edge":"deploy","label":"deploy image"},{"type":"highlight","node":"staging"},{"type":"badge","node":"staging","text":"live","tone":"ok"}]}]}]},"titleCard":{"title":"From push to staging","description":"How every change is checked before it is deployed."},"assumptions":["The audience is developers new to the team who push branches but have not seen the pipeline.","The shape is problem, how it works, outcome: the hook names the need for checks, the middle walks the pipeline, and the end shows the change running on staging.","The graph does not show what happens when a check fails, so the video shows only the all-pass path and does not invent a failure route.","The image is described as a Docker image, as the brief says, and the registry is treated as the place the image is stored before deployment."]}
